them; for they know not what they do’. S.’s exchange of letters with Southey in the summer of 1820
lies behind the marked New Testament tone and allusions of the Preface. S.’s letter of 17 August 1820
speaks to Southey of ‘the wretched hireling who has so closely imitated your style as to deceive all but
those who knew you into a belief that he was you’, and goes on:
